name: alpamayo-r1-10b
prompt: Predict next 64 waypoints from current driving context.
notes: Alpamayo-R1-10B is an autonomous-driving trajectory prediction model with a Qwen3-VL backbone and custom action heads (PerWaypointActionInProj, Unicycle Accel Curvature action space, flow-matching diffusion over trajectories). 4000-token trajectory tokenizer feeds VLM-style decoder; 64 waypoint output via diffusion. Lane is scaffolding only — onboarding needs (1) a new family 'alpamayo_r1' that matches model_type=alpamayo_r1, (2) custom load_weights handling action_in_proj/action_out_proj/traj_tokenizer weights, (3) flow-matching scheduler integration in the runtime, (4) waypoint decoder building on the QwenVL3 backbone in families/qwen_vl. See PR #176 for the qwen_vl TP base.
